description: This PHP script manages the assignment of test plans to test projects within the TestLink open-source testing management system. It verifies user permissions, processes form submissions to change test plan associations, retrieves data about test plans and projects, and displays an interface for editing these associations.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Represents test project entities and provides methods to retrieve all test projects.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Handles template rendering and variable assignment for the front-end display.

methods.name: changeTestProjectForTestPlan
methods.description: Updates the database to associate a specific test plan with a test project.
